moments.author: Matt Vesey
moments.quote: Met Police confirms it received a letter in 2019 containing claims about Meghan’s father, passed it to the Sussexes’ office—but did not share it with other agencies; now reviewing whether to escalate matter to watchdog.
moments.why: It ignited debate over transparency and handling of sensitive information by the Metropolitan Police.

moments.author: WRAL News
moments.quote: Steve Lacy’s concert this Fri., Oct 23 will now be the final performance at the current Red Hat Amphitheater after Victoria Monet had to cancel due to production challenges—the new venue opens in 2027.
moments.why: It marked the end of an iconic local venue and community reflection on change in Raleigh’s live music scene.

moments.author: Kyla Guilfoil
moments.quote: Vanessa Trump says “I am finally cancer‑free,” six months after her breast cancer diagnosis—announced via video with her daughter during Breast Cancer Awareness Month.
moments.why: The heartfelt cancer recovery update combined personal resilience and high-profile family ties, striking an emotional chord.
